title.en: Stable mergesort with persistent item identity

summary: Track duplicate-valued items through recursive splitting and stable merging.
objective: Build a mergesort trace with labeled bars, duplicate keys and a visible auxiliary array so I can verify stable ordering.
intent_signals: Build a mergesort trace with labeled bars, duplicate keys and a visible auxiliary array so I can verify stable ordering.
Track duplicate-valued items through recursive splitting and stable merging.
example_prompts: Build a mergesort trace with labeled bars, duplicate keys and a visible auxiliary array so I can verify stable ordering.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of merge sort visualization with merge workspace.
negative_signals: This is a specific stable mergesort implementation, not a claim that every merge variant is stable.
not_for: This is a specific stable mergesort implementation, not a claim that every merge variant is stable.

entities.name: Identity bars
entities.guidance: Use equal-width bars with height encoding nonnegative key values and a separate original-index label; support zero values without hiding their label.

entities.name: Split tree
entities.guidance: Show recursive index ranges above the main array with a clear base case for ranges of size zero or one.

entities.name: Merge workspace
entities.guidance: Render left/right read pointers and output write pointer over an auxiliary row; keep copied tokens visually distinct from unique logical records.

state_contract.model: Finite array of (finite nonnegative numeric key,originalIndex) records, including duplicates. Sort by key only; top-down mergesort merges sorted halves, choosing the left item first on equal keys.
state_contract.authority: Array records, merge pointers and emitted write events own order; bar positions interpolate between committed index mappings without mutating keys.
actions: Load a short input with repeated keys.
Pause and inspect a merge range.
Reset input and trace, or replay from the beginning.

invariants: The final array is nondecreasing by key and preserves the input multiset.
Equal keys retain original relative order.
Each completed merge range is sorted; temporary buffer copies do not count as extra logical items.
motion_guidance: Commit array writes at event boundaries rather than using proximity of moving bars as the sorting rule.
Allow speed changes to affect playback duration without changing comparison order.
known_limits: This is a specific stable mergesort implementation, not a claim that every merge variant is stable.
The view is for representative short arrays; animation duration is not a benchmark of algorithm speed.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: Top-down mergesort recursively sorts two halves and combines them with a merge operation.
claims.scope: Stable tie handling is an explicit application choice for this recipe.

object_craft.structure: Use equal-width bars with height encoding nonnegative key values and a separate original-index label; support zero values without hiding their label.
object_craft.material: Matte bars with immutable index labels and a muted auxiliary tray; identical key heights remain distinguishable by identity markers.
